description: Endpoint reference and asynchronous workflow for the one approved Agnes video model, agnes-video-2.5-flash (string seconds 4-12, 720P only, modes text/keyframe/reference), on the Agnes AI API gateway. agnes-video-v2.0 was retired by the vendor on 2026-09-25 and is active:false in the registry; the router refuses it, refuses any request over 12 s with "split into clips of 12 s or less", and refuses the V2.0-only request surface. Model choice is driven by the deterministic router scripts/select_agnes_video_model.py (single source of truth; explicit model wins; no silent switch), with the create-task / poll-result pattern, reading returned size/seconds/metadata as the source of truth.
